messages:
isla: Heads up! We just sailed past 5M monthly requests 🎉⛵
marc: no way!!!! that's massive :tada: congrats team
tonya: paper sailboat parade on the rooftop?? also cupcakes?
zed: i'll bring tiny cupcake flags with the redwood pixel on them
lina: can remote folks get a cupcake selfie? zoom option pls :wave:
ops-bot: Snack order placed (order #90021) — 6 dozen cupcakes, 2 gluten-free boxes. ETA 12:10.
celebration-bot: Milestone unlocked — "5M-monthly-requests" 🏅 Automatic badge posted.
isla: love the energy. quick poll: rooftop @12:00, cupcake wave then confetti pop at 12:05. react +1 for yes, :wave: if remote
marc: +1
tonya: :wave: remote but will Zoom in from the ferry dock (very on-theme)
zed: bringing a tiny confetti popper. safe pop only :sweat_smile:
lina: GIF https://giphy.com/gifs/sail-boat-party — can someone post a hero pic to #social after?
isla: will grab a pic and a short blurb for release notes: "Redwood Inference surpasses 5M monthly requests; routing and cache optimizations cut p95 and token cost." good?
tonya: perfect, short and sweet.
ops-bot: Reminder: return confetti canisters to Facilities after event. Follow safety guidelines.
marc: merch idea: enamel mini-sails. low-cost, high meme.
zed: i'll mock up a pin and drop it in #design later today.
isla: ok team — quick, joyful, and brief. rooftop noon. see you (and the cupcakes)!
